title: Check a webhook signature
description:
Accept a webhook only when its signature matches.

```
valid delivery: accepted
body changed: rejected (bad signature)
no signature: rejected (missing header)
```

starter.main.py:
import hashlib
import hmac

SECRET = b"whsec_demo_only"


def verify(headers, body):
    return False


body = b'{"event": "order.paid", "id": "evt_1"}'
good = "sha256=" + hmac.new(SECRET, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
print(verify({"X-Signature": good}, body))

hints: `header.startswith("sha256=")` and then compare the rest with your own digest (lesson 4.02).
Parsing and re-encoding the JSON changes spaces and order, which changes the signature; that is why the raw body is used.
requirements: The sender puts `sha256=<hex>` in the `X-Signature` header, the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with a shared secret.
Check the raw bytes, before parsing the JSON.
stretch: Support two secrets at once while one is being replaced.
